title: Suction gripper head with a foam body

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
features.note: The reference describes a foam body as a carrier, but does not explicitly mention a housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping.

features.item: An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.quote: The suction block 4 is optionally a vacuum generator, such as a compressed air vacuum generator. For example, the vacuum generator is a Venturi effect vacuum generator.
features.note: The reference discloses a vacuum generator in the gripper head, but specifies it as a compressed air or Venturi effect generator, not explicitly an electrically operated one.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference describes a suction path for air being sucked in, but not the guidance of exhaust air from a vacuum generating device through a hollow grip portion.

features.item: A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
features.quote: Optionally, a sound attenuation module 106 of the suction block 104 , of the silencer type, is also received in the first housing 105 .
features.note: The reference discloses a sound attenuation module, but it is arranged in the housing for the suction block, not specifically in a grip portion.

features.item: A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
features.quote: Preferably, the gripper head includes a soleplate 14 secured to the body 1 and having a bottom face 15 that is the face for coming directly into contact with the item to be grasped.
features.note: The soleplate acts as the suction plate, and while a separate carrier plate isn't explicitly named, the soleplate is secured to the foam body, which acts as a carrier. The sealing function is inherent to the soleplate's contact.
features.refuted: The quote describes a soleplate secured to a body with a bottom contact face, but does not mention a carrier plate or a seal extending around any carrier plate.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping in grip
features.note: The reference does not disclose a grip unit with all these combined features, particularly a hollow grip portion for exhaust air and an electrically operated vacuum generator.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus
features.quote: A suction gripper head comprising at least one carrier and a soleplate ( 14 ) for resting against an item to be lifted, the soleplate being arranged in the bottom portion of the carrier.
features.note: The suction gripper head described combines a carrier (which could be considered a grip unit in a broader sense) and a soleplate (suction plate) for handling items.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference mentions a sound attenuation module but does not describe a grip portion lined with sound-damping material.

features.item: Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.quote: Preferably, the suction block 104 is arranged at least in part inside the carrier, and it is preferably arranged inside the carrier so that it does not project therefrom.
features.note: The suction block, which can be a vacuum generator, is described as being arranged inside the carrier (foam body), which acts as a housing.
features.refuted: The quote states the suction block is arranged inside the carrier, not inside a first housing portion as asserted.

features.item: Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
features.quote: Optionally, a sound attenuation module 106 of the suction block 104 , of the silencer type, is also received in the first housing 105 .
features.note: The reference explicitly states that a sound attenuation module can be received in the first housing, which contains the suction block (vacuum generator).

features.item: Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
features.note: The reference does not describe an elongated grip portion between distinct housing portions with an air outlet on a second portion.

features.item: Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not describe an air collection screw or any mechanism for collecting exhaust air upstream of a grip portion.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe bent or curved air baffles for directing exhaust air.

features.item: Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not mention a battery coupling point or air baffles directing exhaust air away from it.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference describes the soleplate being secured to the foam body, but not a releasable connection between a grip unit and suction plate.

features.item: Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.quote: a suction path arranged therein between the soleplate and an outlet orifice of the gripper head for connection to a suction block
features.note: The suction path connects the soleplate (suction chamber) to the outlet orifice for connection to a suction block (part of a grip unit in a broader sense).
features.refuted: The quote describes a suction path between the soleplate and an outlet orifice for connection to a suction block, but does not mention a suction opening or a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate.

claims.note: This reference describes a suction gripper head, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device.

claims.quote: The suction block 4 is optionally a vacuum generator, such as a compressed air vacuum generator.
claims.note: The reference discloses a vacuum generating device (suction block) and a housing (carrier/foam body), but not a grip portion for gripping the unit, nor that the vacuum generator is electrically operated.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body. It describes a foam body as a carrier.
The reference describes a suction path for air being sucked in, but not exhaust air discharged through a grip portion to an air outlet.

claims.quote: Optionally, a sound attenuation module 106 of the suction block 104 , of the silencer type, is also received in the first housing 105 .
claims.note: The reference discloses a sound attenuation module (sound-damping device) within the gripper head, but not specifically within a 'grip portion' as defined in the claim context. The 'first housing' is where the suction block is received, which is part of the overall gripper head, but not explicitly a 'grip portion' for a hand-operated device.
The reference does not disclose the grip portion being lined with a sound-damping material. It mentions a sound attenuation module, but not a lining.

claims.quote: Preferably, the suction block 104 is arranged at least in part inside the carrier, and it is preferably arranged inside the carrier so that it does not project therefrom.
claims.note: The reference discloses the suction block (vacuum generating device) being arranged inside the carrier (housing), but not necessarily 'completely' in a 'first housing portion'. It states 'at least in part' and 'inside the carrier'.

claims.quote: Optionally, a sound attenuation module 106 of the suction block 104 , of the silencer type, is also received in the first housing 105 .
claims.note: The reference discloses a sound attenuation module (sound-reducing device) being received in the first housing, but does not explicitly state that the first housing portion is lined with sound-reducing material.

This reference describes a suction gripper head with a foam body and a soleplate, but does not describe a grip unit with an elongated grip portion between a first and second housing portion, nor an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.

This reference describes a suction gripper head, but does not disclose an air collection device in the form of an air collection screw arranged upstream of a grip portion in a first housing portion for collecting exhaust air.

This reference describes a suction gripper head, but does not disclose bent or curved air baffles arranged downstream of a grip portion in a second housing portion for guiding exhaust air to an air outlet.

This reference describes a suction gripper head, but does not disclose a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery arranged on a housing, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a coupling point.
The reference does not disclose air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.

claims.quote: The invention also provides a gripper system comprising a gripper structure and a gripper head as specified above.
claims.note: The reference discloses a gripper system comprising a gripper structure and a gripper head, which is equivalent to a vacuum handling apparatus.
claims.refuted: The quote describes a gripper system with gripper structure and head, not a vacuum handling apparatus.

claims.note: The reference discloses a soleplate secured to the body, which acts as a carrier plate, and a bottom face for contact with an item. However, it does not explicitly state that the soleplate includes a seal fastened to it and extending around it.
The full text of claim 1 of the subject invention is not provided, so it is not possible to assess if this reference discloses 'said grip unit according to claim 1'.
The reference describes a suction gripper head with a soleplate and a foam body, but does not explicitly mention a grip unit and a suction plate being releasably connected via a coupling device.

claims.quote: a suction path arranged therein between the soleplate and an outlet orifice of the gripper head for connection to a suction block
claims.note: The reference discloses a suction path between the soleplate and an outlet orifice for connection to a suction block, which generates a vacuum. However, it does not explicitly mention a 'grip unit' having a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate.

overall.why: The reference describes a suction gripper head with a foam body, a soleplate, and a suction block, which aligns with some core concepts of a vacuum handling apparatus.
